name: Sour taste and acid sensing by ion channels
rationale: Members concern sensing of acidic/alkaline pH by TRP and TALK channels and sour taste, which separates them from other-taste/smell, CFTR and other two-pore K+ channel themes.

name: Glucose-6-phosphate turnover and glycogen breakdown regulation
rationale: Members cover glucose-6-phosphatase/G6P transporter defects, glucokinase regulation, hexose phosphate transport and glycogenolysis/glycogen synthesis regulation, unlike confusables centred on glycolysis, glucagon/PKA, gluconeogenesis or glycogen synthesis disorders.

name: Glycerophospholipid and sphingolipid synthesis, remodeling and transfer
rationale: Members span synthesis and acyl-chain remodeling of PC/PE/PS/PG/PI/CL plus sphingolipid/ceramide metabolism and ER-Golgi lipid transfer, the sphingolipid and transfer parts being absent from all confusables.

core: Guide RNP assembly and RNA modification
name: Guide snoRNP/scaRNP assembly, Cajal body targeting and RNA modification
rationale: Members concern box C/D snoRNP assembly, snoRNA/scaRNA and telomerase RNA localization to Cajal bodies and snRNA/rRNA modification, distinct from confusables about telomere extension, rRNA processing or transcription.

name: Intestinal and renal hexose and urate transport
rationale: Members are SLC2/SLC5 hexose transport and absorption plus SLC22/SLC2A9 urate transport and their defects, distinct from confusables on disaccharide digestion, cystine or imino acid transport.

name: Neutral amino acid and oligopeptide plasma membrane transport
rationale: Members are transport of neutral/imino amino acids and di/oligopeptides (SLC6, SLC36, proton-coupled peptide transporters) and their defects, unlike confusables on cationic amino acid, cystine or urate transport.

name: Cytolytic and antifungal antimicrobial humoral defense
rationale: Members concern killing and cytolysis of other organisms, antifungal and anti-Gram-positive responses, metal sequestration and neutrophil cytotoxicity, whereas confusables emphasise bacterial attachment, agglutination, mucosal immunity or defensins.

core: Cytidine deamination in viral restriction and antibody diversification
name: HIV early replication, APOBEC3G restriction and antibody diversification
rationale: Members combine HIV entry-to-integration steps and APOBEC3G/cytidine deaminase restriction with B cell somatic hypermutation, class switching and V(D)J recombination, the antibody diversification side being absent from all confusables.

name: Lipoprotein receptor lysosomal degradation limiting LDL clearance
rationale: Members concern LDLR/VLDLR internalisation and lysosomal degradation, reduced recycling and LXR-driven limitation of cholesterol uptake, unlike confusables on sterol sensing or general receptor internalization.

core: Specialised O-glycan and keratan sulfate synthesis
name: Dystroglycan O-mannosylation and keratan sulfate metabolism
rationale: Members are DAG1 O-mannosyl core/matriglycan synthesis and its dystroglycanopathies plus keratan sulfate synthesis/degradation defects, distinct from other GAG synthesis and muscle/basement membrane themes.

name: Lung, trachea and diaphragm development
rationale: Members cover lung branching, mesenchyme, vasculature, saccule and pneumocyte development plus trachea and diaphragm formation, unlike confusables on salivary branching or surfactant metabolism.

name: GDP-mannose and dolichyl-phosphate mannose synthesis and disorders
rationale: Members are synthesis of GDP-mannose, dolichyl-phosphate and Dol-P-Man and their CDG defects (PMM2, MPI, DPM1-3, DOLK, SRD5A3), upstream of the ALG/GPI/UDP-sugar steps in confusables.

name: Dendrite arborization and filopodial actin remodeling
rationale: Members regulate dendrite branching, spine and filopodium formation and postsynaptic actin via EPHB and RHOF, unlike confusables on postsynaptic density, microtubules or BDNF signalling.

name: Phospholipid acyl-chain remodeling and endocannabinoid lipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members are Lands-cycle remodeling and lysophospholipid hydrolysis plus DAG/MAG and N-acylethanolamine turnover in endocannabinoid signalling, unlike confusables centred on de novo phospholipid or sphingolipid synthesis.

name: N-glycan glucosylation, mannose trimming and hybrid/complex processing
rationale: Members concern Dol-P-Glc/UDP-glucose donors, glucosidase/mannosidase trimming (MOGS, MAN1B1), hybrid and complex N-glycan reactions and lysosomal oligosaccharide catabolism, distinct from sialylation, nucleotide-sugar transport and O-glycan themes.

name: Phosphatidic acid, diacylglycerol and triglyceride synthesis and lipolysis
rationale: Members cover PA, DAG, MAG and TAG synthesis/remodeling plus lipase-driven triglyceride catabolism (incl. PDE3B), unlike confusables on lipid droplet dynamics and lipophagy.

name: Endocardial cushion EMT, valve and septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover endocardial cushion EMT and fusion, valve and septum morphogenesis and adjacent great-artery development, unlike confusables on myocardial/ventricular growth or neural crest outflow tract.

name: Autophagosome assembly regulation and ER/nucleus-selective autophagy
rationale: Members regulate phagophore/autophagosome assembly and maturation and include reticulophagy and nuclear microautophagy, unlike confusables on mitophagy, pexophagy or aggrephagy.

name: Chylomicron and VLDL lipolytic remodeling and clearance
rationale: Members concern LPL/LIPC assembly and chylomicron/VLDL remodeling and clearance, unlike confusables on LDL/HDL remodeling or intestinal lipid absorption.

name: Histone and non-histone protein acetylation
rationale: Members concern lysine, N-terminal and histone acetylation and its regulation (tubulin deacetylation, centriole replication, redox), unlike confusables on chromatin remodeling, histone methylation or heat shock.

name: Spinal cord patterning and motor neuron/interneuron specification
rationale: Members cover dorsoventral neural tube/spinal cord patterning and specification, differentiation and migration of motor and interneurons, unlike confusables on neural plate, forebrain or cortex development.

name: Dolichyl-phosphate mannose synthase complex and its CDG defects
rationale: All members concern DPM1/DPM2/DPM3 forming Dol-P-Man and their CDG defects, distinct from confusables on ALG, PMM2, MPI or DOLK steps.

name: Antifungal and cytolytic killing with antimicrobial metal sequestration
rationale: Members concern killing and cytolysis of other organisms, antifungal and anti-Gram-positive defense, metal sequestration and neutrophil cytotoxicity, unlike confusables on antimicrobial peptide production, defensins, agglutination or respiratory burst.

qualifier: plasma membrane reuptake and vesicular loading
name: Catecholamine reuptake and vesicular monoamine loading
rationale: Members concern dopamine/norepinephrine transporter uptake (SLC6A2/SLC6A3 defects) and monoamine loading into synaptic vesicles, unlike confusables on dopamine receptor signalling or synthesis.

name: Phosphate transport and homeostasis in bone and tooth mineralization
rationale: Members cover Na+/Pi cotransporters and their defects, FGF23-Klotho/PTH phosphate regulation and bone, enamel and dentin mineralization, unlike confusables on bicarbonate/anion transport, vitamin D or odontogenesis.
